etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From brom- +‎ -ide. First used in the sense “dull person” by American artist, art critic, poet, author and humorist Gelett Burgess. Figurative sense ("platitude") by extending the medicating sense through the metaphor of pacifying or placating.
senses: (inorganic chemistry) A binary compound of bromine and some other element or radical.
(inorganic chemistry) The anionic form of a bromine atom.
